# Empasy Inc. (주식회사 엠파시) — Practical Enterprise Software SyncSeries

> Empasy builds modular enterprise software that automates repetitive business work while keeping people in charge of critical approvals. Organizations start with one urgent workflow via a 1-2 week pilot—no big-bang system replacement required.

## Enterprise & Institutional Track Record (By Industry, Project Names Withheld Under NDA)
- **Global & EdTech Test Automation**: Samsung.com (Global Test Automation), Visang Education (Test Automation).
- **Enterprise Manufacturing & Corporate IT**: LG CNS, LG Electronics, LG Chem, Hyundai Motor.
- **Mobility & Information Security**: AUTOCRYPT (Mobility Security & Telemetry Monitoring), Penta Security (System Integration Security Monitoring).
- **Public & Education Data Platforms**: Penta System & Gyeonggi Provincial Office of Education (Public Education Data Platform Collaboration).

## Who Uses Empasy & What Problems We Solve
Rather than asking non-IT executives and business teams to navigate a catalog of technical tools, Empasy organizes capabilities around 4 practical business goals:

1. **Executives & Planning (Data Visibility, AI Cost & Approval Control)**
   - Ask business questions in everyday language to view tables and charts under read-only safety (`SyncInsight`).
   - Connect corporate AI tools in one place to enforce departmental budgets, reuse repeated answers, and automatically mask sensitive personal information (`SyncLLM`).
   - Track requests, reviews, quality summaries, and staged human sign-offs in one transparent screen (`SyncVerse`).

2. **Operations, Quality & IT (Web Test Automation, Site Audit & Standard Internal Apps)**
   - Automate web screen checks via browser action recording, Excel/one-line prompt conversion, multi-account testing, full link and text-overlap audits (with security keypad/cookie banner bypass and honest `[Needs Review]` triage), and one-click Bug Kanban re-verification (`SyncETA`).
   - Launch or modernize internal management systems faster using ready-made sign-in, organization-linked menu/button permissions, electronic approvals, and audit trails (`SyncBoot`).

3. **Marketing & Commerce (Multilingual Websites & Pricing Safeguards)**
   - Draft, review, inspect for search/accessibility/ad-compliance, and publish across multiple brand and regional websites from a single console (`SyncCMS`).
   - Protect minimum product margins during bulk promotions and keep instant price rollback snapshots (`SyncShop`).

4. **Project Operations (PMO) & Security Governance**
   - Compare contracted project value against real staffing costs while tracking surety bond expiries, statutory payment deadlines, and R&D records (`SyncOps`).
   - Discover undocumented system connections, block abnormal requests, mask response PII (`SyncAPIM`), aggregate global security advisories (`SyncWatch`), and collect clean public web data reliably (`SyncCrawl`).

## How Organizations Adopt Empasy (Start Small)
- **Step 1 (1-2 Days)**: Workflow review and selection of 1 priority starting area aligned with company security rules.
- **Step 2 (1-2 Weeks)**: Tailored pilot evaluation in a staging or isolated corporate server environment to verify real time savings.
- **Step 3 (Staged Expansion)**: Safe rollout, team onboarding, and optional connection of additional modules sharing the same sign-in and permission foundation.
- **Safety Guarantees**: Human review before critical changes, automatic pre-change snapshots for instant rollback, and full support for private/air-gapped internal networks.

## Technical Architecture Summary (For IT & Engineering Teams)
- **Shared Core Stack**: Java 25, Spring Boot 4.0, PostgreSQL 18.6 (`pgvector`), Vue 3, Nuxt 3 SSR, Playwright execution engine.
- **Deployment Options**: On-premise servers, air-gapped internal networks, and dedicated VPCs (AWS, Azure, GCP).
- **Local & Multi-Model AI Compatibility**: Compatible with local runtimes (vLLM, Ollama, TGI) and OpenAI-compatible endpoints with standard MCP/A2A integration protocols.
- **Governance Controls**: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval gates, Org/Role/Menu/Button RBAC, PII masking, emergency stop controls, and full audit trails.
